lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Make sure to tell future me she raised you right.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, I've got a lot to tell you.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm gonna miss you, Trunks.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Have a safe trip back to the future, McFly!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Goodbye, everyone! I'll never forget you!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: See you in seventeen years, sweetie!
TARDIS sounds from Trunks's time machine

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Hahaha! Suck on that wurst, Einstein!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Collapse that wave function all over your pasty German a--

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Trunks! Oh, you're back! Thank goodness you're...

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: ...Everything go well?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hey, Mom! You ever meet Dad?

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: (sigh)

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Okay, look, love is complicated.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Seriously, how was I supposed to prepare you for a year alone with him?

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: I never even got a week.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Mom, you didn't prepare me for a car ride to the grocery store with the man.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: What did you see in him?

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: A short, stubborn, powerful person desperate for recognition.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: As a female scientist in her early 30s, I... guess I identified with that.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: (sigh) I just wish I could have.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Well, apparently you're his baby boy, so... he wasn't all bad, right?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: A revelation that came at the cost of my literal life.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Then again, considering the dysfunction of that whole group... maybe I'm not the worst off.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Yeah. Because I raised you right.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, about that...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Before you found out I was your son, in the past... you might have made a pass at me.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Well, duh.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Mom!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Hey, it's not my fault your dad's genetics and mine go along like chocolate and peanut butter.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Is that why you used to call me your "little peanut butter cup"?
radio static

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: This is Alpha Leader Wombat, coming at you live from Parsley City!

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: We've got our special guest, the Cyborgs, and they are *TEARING IT UP*!

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: Our radio lost five men, I'm running out of ammo and I'm holed up in the bank!

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: Looks like this will be ALW's last report!

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: Watch out, TJ, I'M COMING HOME, BROTHA!

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: [300 audio clip] "But tonight, we dine in he--!"
radio cutoff

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Perfect. Just saved me the effort of hunting them down.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Be careful. I know you're stronger, but I don't want history repeating itself.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Don't worry, Mom. I'll be back before that tea gets cold.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Actually, it's-- it's probably gonna take me a little while to get there, so...

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Right, so, want me to put in a thermos,

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You can just a--

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: make more when you get back--

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You know, I'll just... I'll just finish it now.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: repeating short shouts and ki blast noises

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You know, sis, they say catharsis is actually bad for your health...

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: And so is calling me a – quote – "hoe-bot" – end quote!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I'd've gone with "ro-thot".

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I'm not even an android!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Duh, since you're a girl, you'd obviously be a guynoid, which is funny considering "guy" isn't a...
gunshot, ricocheting noise

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Mother...

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: (shocked gasp)

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Not a bad shot, pops.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Must be popular down at the shooting range.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I, on the other hand, have terrible aim.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I gotta get up real close, see?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: So do me a favor. Sit still.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: If you're readin' this...
gunshot

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Oh, right. "Gynoid". Like "gynecology". Huh.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: It's obvious when I think about it.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Get away from him!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I hope you got everything out of your wretched lives you wanted, because they end today!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Nobody else is going to...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Probably could have microwaved that tea.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Well well well. Hey there, Lilac! It's been a few weeks.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Surprised you're on your feet already! Also breathing.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: See, 17? This is what you get when you don't double-tap.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Also, does he look different to you?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Yeah - ditched the sword, lost the jacket, plus you got *jacked*.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You must be crushing that 5-by-5.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Also, did you get a little taller?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Jesus Christ, swipe right already!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Pretty sure he's more your type.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: No thanks. I'm into shorter men.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Sis, watch out--!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: GODDAMN CHEAPSHOTTING ASSHOLE!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Now, it's too bad you left that sword at home... 'cause now I'm going to have to do what comes next with my bare hands!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Is this a bad time to point out his specific choice in shirt?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You know, it's funny and a little bit sad.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You two Androids didn't have to turn out like this. The ones I met in the--

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Hold up, did you call us "Androids"? That's offensive.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Again with this shit?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, right. They called you "Androids" in the past.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: "The past"? What, did you time-travel?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Uh... yeah.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Wait, when was that? Shouldn't we remember you?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: How about this... If I don't kill you in the next minute, I'll give you an explanation.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Trust me, wife-beater... By the time we're done with you, we won't need one.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Wait a second! That's what you meant by his choice in shirt? Jesus, dude!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: What, are you kidding?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I put a bullet in some dude's gray matter not two minutes ago and that's what's got you offended?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Wait--

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Any chance that I could talk you out of this?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: What was my Master's name?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: The man who taught me. The man whose arm you took.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: The man *you killed*.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: *What was his name*?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Goooo.... ku Junior...?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Wrong answer!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: You really think he's going to take the bait?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I have a corpse in another timeline that says: yes, he will.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Now stick to the script, Mom.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Jeez, morbid.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Ahem...
Whimsical music

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Alright, son!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Time to take this *time machine* back to the *past*, where there are *two living CYBORGS* for you to help Goku defeat!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Thanks, Mom!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I can't wait to save all those juicy fat people in the past from those CYBORGS with this TIME MACHINE!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Make sure to write!
Bulma laughing
Bulma and Trunks laughing
Cell entering noisily
Bulma and Trunks laughing
Whimsical music ends

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Huh?
Whimsical music ends

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Oh shit, is that him?

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: You know, you never told me he was green, but I imagined he was green.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Mom...

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: He's looking right at us. Does he... Does he know I can see him?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: (hungry growl)

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Is his vision based on movement?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Mom! Script!
Whimsical music

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Alright, son! I'm going to make dinner!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: It'll be done by the time you get back!
Whimsical music ends

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Alright, tall dark and bugly. I know you're there.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: No, you don't; this is an ambush--

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: ...Ooooh.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Also, I know you're here to kill me and take my time machine, so let's skip the monologue.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Also, you killing me.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Nahh, but that's the fun part!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: And unfortunately, I seem to be missing two... vital pieces.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: So, I'm gonna need that time machine so I can--

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: --go back in the past and absorb the Cyborgs--

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: --to achieve my--

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: --perfect form.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Okay, you suck. You are sucking all the fun out of this!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I'm the only one who sucks here, boy--!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: That came out wrong.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Nah, sounds right to me.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: Seriously, whose DNA made him look like he stepped into a teleporter with Jeff Goldblum?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: How... how do you know all this?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Because... someone once told me... Multiverse theory is a bitch.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Okay, I feel like you're referencing something, and I don't get it, and that's not fair.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: So I'm really gonna need that time machine now, so I can just go back and redo this whole conversation.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Sorry, Cell. You already got your way once.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Wait, "Cell"? Is that my name?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Oh man, that's way better than the name I came up with!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: I was thinking... "Jiren".

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Yeah, see, I though it was boring too.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I hope you're prepared to meet your maker... in Hell!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Because I'm pretty sure that's where Dr. Gero is.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Ohohoho. You think you're cute?!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Bitch... I'm adorable.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Boy howdy, kids. Looks like your old friend Cell's in quite a sticky wicket.

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Whatever should he do?

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Use the Kamehameha? Good idea!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Kaaa... meee...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: HAAAAAAA!

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: Letmefinish!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: GET OUT OF MY F***ING TIMELINE!
♪ Frank Sinatra - "My Way" ♪

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: ♪ And now... the end is near-- ♪

lines.speaker: Cell
lines.text: AH GODDAMMIT!! SHIIIII...!!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: 'It's over.'

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: 'After everything, this feels... this feels... anticlimact--'

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: So, truth be told, I never really got to know your father that well.

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: He and I shared one night of passion after he came back to Earth.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Mom, you--

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: And unfortunately, he didn't know what "protection" meant!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I really don't need to know this!

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: But after that first time, I just thought:

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: "Well, in for a penny, in for a pounding."

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: [disgusted, nervous] Aaaaaahhhh...

lines.speaker: Future Bulma
lines.text: And I really was!
